description: Smoke fixture for the bundled show_images package: the recipe answers with the fixed line the chat turn gives the model. In a chat turn the hub answers the call itself and fetches the pictures beside the answer (backend/src/lib/answerImages/turn.ts); that path is covered by backend/tests/answerImagesTurn.test.ts, not this emulator.
